class.comment: Minimal API endpoint handlers, mapped by MapCatalogApi (groups api, v1 and v2 under api/catalog). The catalogtypes and catalogbrands endpoints are inline lambdas and aren't modelled. GetCatalogFacets, GetItemsByIds, CreateItem and DeleteItemById carry [IntentIgnore] in the code: RoslynWeaver would re-wrap their attributed parameters flush-left.
